stem: A test tracks 20 metrics. One shows p = 0.03; the other 19 are not significant. The team wants to report the test as a win on that metric. What is the problem?

options.text: There is none: p = 0.03 is below 0.05, so the win on that metric is real
With 20 metrics, about one falls below 0.05 by chance, so it may be noise
The other 19 metrics show that the change does harm, so the test is a loss
p = 0.03 means a 97% chance that the change really improved that metric
